about.description: A legendary beachfront restaurant and bar in Gulf Shores established in 1956, known for its distinctive pink exterior and serving fresh Gulf seafood and burgers. The Pink Pony Pub has survived hurricanes and changes over decades while maintaining its historic charm and neighborhood atmosphere.
